flags: Price gate: the one-night rate on the operator's Newbook engine is $70 (RV Standard) / $80 (Super Site) for 2026-11-10, over US$50; no gateway within 40 km (nearest: Everglades NP 102 km, West Palm Beach 139 km). The family has not stayed here.

Long-stay rule: looks mostly residential - rootsmg.com calls it 'a welcoming 55+ manufactured home community' with park models and homes for sale and rent; summer dates sell only 30-night stays. Fails test 1 (price) at $70 a night.

Water claim (minor re-audit lead): rootsmg.com sells 'peaceful waterfront living with private docks ... riverfront living' on the Caloosahatchee; the entry is 'not waterfront'. The claim is about the homes/park models, not RV sites.
